title: International merchandise trade by province, commodity, and Principal Trading Partners
basis: Domestic merchandise exports on a customs basis, unadjusted, current Canadian dollars. Province of origin, not port of exit. Latest retrieved vintage, not a reconstructed historical vintage. Re-exports and services excluded. Topic groups are broad product categories, not exact EV/battery or seafood industry totals.
